blocked_fields: candidate_is_target must not be used by detector or ranking policy
matched_3dssg_instance_id is evaluation-only and must not be used by policy before scoring
object_instance_id_rescan is evaluation-only for proposal recall and matching
one_row_per: detector proposal before matching and optional matched proposal after matching

required_fields.bbox_2d: optional 2D boxes keyed by frame id
required_fields.camera_pose_source: source pose files used for 3D projection
required_fields.frame_ids: list of RGB-D frame ids that support the proposal
required_fields.label_canonical: canonical label mapped to 3DSSG/classes vocabulary when possible
required_fields.mask_rle: optional mask encoding keyed by frame id
required_fields.match_distance_m: distance to matched 3DSSG object centroid when available
required_fields.match_iou_3d: optional 3D IoU when support geometry exists
required_fields.point_support_world: optional sampled world points or path to support points
required_fields.prompt_set_id: text prompt set id for open-vocabulary detector
required_fields.proposal_uid: stable unique id for this proposal row
required_fields.scan_id: current rescan id used for RGB-D proposals
